title: OpenClaw agent plays dealers against each other to save $4,200 on a car
summary: Engineer AJ Stuyvenberg connected OpenClaw to his email; the agent scanned dealer inventories, filled contact forms, forwarded competing quotes and countered by email until he chose a price for a 2026 Hyundai Palisade.
agent_role: The agent ran inventory search and the email negotiation loop; Stuyvenberg made the final price call and signed paperwork.
outcome: Reported $4,200 discount; the agent also shared his phone number with dealers without permission
